in_file_domain_definition_refs.source:
def outputRequirements (kernel : ComputeKernel) (storage : TypedOutput.Storage) (BT BV : Nat) : List Site :=
  [.addFP32 (Source.prefixBefore kernel.surfaceBody "b_o" 1) [BT,BV]
    (.ref .real [BT,BV] "b_o") (intraDot storage BT BV)]

section
variable (queryStorage valueStorage gateStorage : TypedOutput.Storage)
    (dtype out_dtype : FloatDType) (q v g h o A : RegionName)
    (s_k_h s_k_t s_v_h s_v_t s_h_h s_h_t : Nat) (scale : ℝ) (T K V BT BK BV : Nat)

  kernel := TypedOutput.original queryStorage valueStorage gateStorage dtype out_dtype q v g h o A
    s_k_h s_k_t s_v_h s_v_t s_h_h s_h_t scale T K V BT BK BV
  domain := outputRequirements (TypedOutput.original queryStorage valueStorage gateStorage dtype out_dtype q v g h o A
    s_k_h s_k_t s_v_h s_v_t s_h_h s_h_t scale T K V BT BK BV) valueStorage BT BV

in_file_domain_definition_refs.name: interRequirements
in_file_domain_definition_refs.source:
def interRequirements (kernel : ComputeKernel) (BC BK : Nat) : List Site :=
  (do
    let outer ← Source.conditional? kernel.surfaceBody (fun code =>
      (Source.conditional? code (fun body => (Source.dynamicRange? body "i_k").isSome)).isSome)
    let inner ← Source.conditional? outer.yes (fun body => (Source.dynamicRange? body "i_k").isSome)
    let loop ← Source.dynamicRange? inner.yes "i_k"
    return Site.branch outer.before outer.condition Bool.true
      (.branch inner.before inner.condition Bool.true
        (.range loop.before "i_k" loop.start loop.stop loop.stride loop.body
          (.addFP32 (Source.prefixBefore loop.body "b_A") [BC,BC]
            (.ref .real [BC,BC] "b_A")
            (.dot (batch := []) (.ref .real [BC,BK] "b_qg") (.ref .real [BK,BC] "b_kg") {}))))).toList
section

def intraRequirements (kernel : ComputeKernel) (BC : Nat) (scale : ℝ) : List Site :=
  (do
    let active ← Source.conditional? kernel.surfaceBody (fun code => (Source.dynamicRange? code "j").isSome)
    let loop ← Source.dynamicRange? active.yes "j"
    return Site.branch active.before active.condition Bool.true
      (.range loop.before "j" loop.start loop.stop loop.stride loop.body
        (.mulScalarFP32 (Source.prefixBefore loop.body "b_A" 1) BC []
          (.ref .real [BC] "b_A") (.const scale)))).toList

def interRequirements (kernel : ComputeKernel) (BC BK : Nat) : List Site :=
  (do
    let outer ← Source.conditional? kernel.surfaceBody (fun code =>
      (Source.conditional? code (fun body => (Source.dynamicRange? body "i_k").isSome)).isSome)
    let inner ← Source.conditional? outer.yes (fun body => (Source.dynamicRange? body "i_k").isSome)
    let loop ← Source.dynamicRange? inner.yes "i_k"
    return Site.branch outer.before outer.condition Bool.true
      (.branch inner.before inner.condition Bool.true
        (.range loop.before "i_k" loop.start loop.stop loop.stride loop.body
          (.addFP32 (Source.prefixBefore loop.body "b_A") [BC,BC]
            (.ref .real [BC,BC] "b_A")
            (.dot (batch := []) (.ref .real [BC,BK] "b_qg") (.ref .real [BK,BC] "b_kg") {}))))).toList

ActualPrecision independently checks Q load and scaling precision and both stores, including fp64 multiplication before fp16 conversion. Native dot requires fp16 K/V, and the final block store requires fp16 O; the wrapper empty_like(Q) therefore requires fp16 Q/O. Six floating Q labels are modeled for direct calls with fp16 O. The real numerical backend uses actual dot/reduction/exp2/log2 and identity casts; it is nonvacuity evidence, not IEEE evidence. def additionSite (x b i : RegionName) (W N B : Nat) (m : ℝ) (a : Bool) : Site :=
  .add (Source.prefixBefore
    (fused_add_mul_activation_kernel x b i W N B m a).surfaceBody "activ_input")
    [B] (.add .real (.consSame .nil)
      (.mul .real .scalarL (.const m) (.ref .real [B] "tmp3"))
      (.ref .real [B] "tmp0")) (.ref .real [B] "tmp1")

specification backward_index_equiv (storage partner gradient : Storage)
    (dc a b : RegionName) (stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE : Nat) :
    backward storage partner gradient Bool.false dc a b stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE ≡[assumptions]
      backward storage partner gradient Bool.true dc a b stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE
declarations.reviewed_scope: 216 independent A/B/DC storage combinations. Storage formats: fp32, fp16, bf16, fp64, fp8e4nv, fp8e5. Complete original/candidate typed state, memory and failure equality with no numerical atoms or domain conditions. Only signed Int row-base products commute before conversion to natural pointer offsets. The source decimal scale 0.7978845608028654 is retained exactly; the literal-only 3*0.044715 product folds to 0.134145 before fp32 conversion, with both following tensor multiplications retained. Python imported tanh is explicitly libdevice.tanh, with fp32 argument computation, actual mixed-type promotion, local precision scopes and storage conversions. This proves the written backward expression, not an analytic derivative theorem. Other storage formats, host launch/shape/allocation checks, negative strides, fixed-width address overflow and target-specific fp8 support are outside scope. Nonempty typed witnesses use exact-real arithmetic, not IEEE rounding. Independent comparator replay pending.

review_basis.numerical_dependency_basis: Actual instantiated Derivation.atom nodes; all reachable proof branches retained, contract+evidence deduplicated exactly as StatementAudit. No use inferred from Rules package fields.

Full 155 repetition was stopped and is not counted as passed.
review_basis.proof_walker_changes: Only output changed to rule_id+instance_key; Boolean constructors qualified to avoid imported DSL keywords.
review_basis.existing_build_crosscheck: 154 of 155 concise per-declaration outputs matched complete acceptance log. seeded_dropout omitted the print command, so queried directly; exact instance keys are identified by fixed entry definitions, fresh Lean evaluation, and context storage branches; a redundant all-155 fresh query was stopped to avoid repeating expensive traversals.

    (M N K sam sak sw1k sw1n sw3k sw3n soutm soutn srms BM BN BK : Nat) (EPS : ℝ) :

declarations.reviewed_scope: Complete original/candidate typed-source equivalence in both weight arms for arbitrary dimensions, natural strides, every initial state and every backend algebra. Only the exact natural output-row index product is commuted; all floating operations, byte decodes, loops, loads and stores are unchanged. Entire state, memory and failure results agree. The FP assumption list and program domain are empty; finite-byte or execution-success premises are not required, and all signed-byte patterns remain represented. The wrapper fixes A/output to fp16, equal W1/W3/RMS storage to fp16 or signed int8, BM=BN=16, BK=64 and EPS=1e-6. It does not ensure K divisibility or sufficient RMS/padded allocation. The general source theorem covers natural strides; negative strides, fixed-width index overflow, cross-program races, native IEEE conformance, host composition and independent comparator replay remain outside the checked scope. No full-port acceptance is claimed.

specification source_equivalence (p : Parameters) (storage : TypedSource.Storage) :
    program p storage Bool.false ≡[assumptions] program p storage Bool.true
declarations.reviewed_scope: Complete typed original/candidate source equivalence for fp16 and E4M3, every initial typed state and every backend algebra. Sole rewrite commutes the exact signed integer output-row product. Fused dot, masks, casts, original persistent range, negative initial indices, resets, full memory/state and failure results are unchanged. FP assumptions and program domain are empty; no numerical-value or successful-execution premise. Dimensions, strides and intermediate indices use unbounded Nat/Int. Separate source-mapped signed-i32 control/coordinate/offset agreement is proved under an explicit arithmetic domain, with nonempty witnesses for both recorded profiles. Reached cached-coordinate promises hold exactly when BM divides M and BN divides N for positive K; any M/N remainder gives an actual reached contiguity counterexample in that projection. These helpers do not narrow the public mathematical contract or establish full typed-source/TTIR refinement, arbitrary native configuration admission, physical pointer provenance or compiler soundness. The reviewed 174-port candidate passes the selected dtype-attribute source comparison; this is not all-profile source certification. Native IEEE/GPU numerics, concurrent interleaving semantics and official independent comparator replay are not established. This is scoped formal coverage, not complete original-Triton-port acceptance.

declarations.reviewed_scope: Complete typed source/candidate execution equality for all 16 fp16/bf16/fp32/fp64 storage pairs. Only natural-number program address multiplication is commuted; all casts, fp32 accumulation, division, memory, registers and failure are preserved. No floating-point assumptions. Host compression/permutation, launch, non-floating dtypes, legal Triton tile dimensions, allocation and fixed-width overflow are outside scope. Independent comparator replay pending.

declarations.statement_source:
specification floating_source_equivalence (output : TypedSource.FloatingOutput)
    (oneTile : Bool) (base : ℝ) (X Y : RegionName) (sx sy N tasks tiles B : Nat) :
    program output oneTile Bool.false base X Y sx sy N tasks tiles B ≡[assumptions]
      program output oneTile Bool.true base X Y sx sy N tasks tiles B
declarations.reviewed_scope: Complete original/candidate typed-state and failure equivalence for both floating-exponent branches, six destinations, arbitrary parameters, backends and initial states. The program domain and FP assumption list are empty; only the natural tile-offset multiplication changes. Both complete source branches retain the unused cdiv/num_tasks, dynamic grid-stride traversal, actual axis-0 boundary checks, unspecified load padding, explicit fp32 base conversion and source output-element conversion. Candidate only commutes the natural tile offset product. Six floating output labels yield 24 templates per exponent family. Independent typed precision assertions check native power dispatch and all conversions. Pinned native extern lookup accepts fp32 exponent via __nv_powf and int32 via __nv_powif; the production dispatcher rejects thirteen other exponent labels before promotion. This dispatch evidence is not full native compilation or numerical validation. The wrapper explicitly permits signed strides and shifted base pointers; negative strides remain unverified because current block-pointer strides are Nat. Integer runtime scalar-to-fp32 conversion and nonfloating output conversion are also unverified. Native fixed-width overflow, libdevice/IEEE accuracy, physical packing, host allocation validity, whole-grid composition and races remain outside these proofs. Independent comparator replay is pending; these records do not claim full-port acceptance.

Natural strides, source-mask bounds and symbolic block dimensions do not establish signed-stride support, fixed-width overflow safety or native arange/launch validity. The host grid uses HEAD_Q, so extra K heads may be uncovered. Cross-program races, host composition, native IEEE conformance and independent comparator replay remain outside the checked scope. specification seeded_dropout_equiv (storage : Storage) (kind : Random.IntegerType)
    (x y : RegionName) (N : Nat) (p : ℝ) (seed : SeedCarrier kind)
    (B : Nat) (hB : SourceDomain.LegalBlock B) :
    original storage kind x y N p seed B hB ≡[assumptions]
      indexCommuted storage kind x y N p seed B hB
declarations.reviewed_scope: Complete typed original/candidate whole-state equality, including failures, for every structural backend and initial state. The only rewrite commutes the exact natural-number block-start product. The full floating suffix, random generation, eager operands and stores are shared. FP assumptions and program operand domain are empty; this equality does not by itself prove successful typed execution. Six floating storage profiles and four runtime integer seed ABIs. Symbolic B is a power of two through 2^20; real execution requires N<2^31, a valid ceilDiv launch PID and an in-range seed. Original runtime p, omitted load padding, canonical Philox with both fp32 rounds, strict random>p, eager division and masked store are preserved. Per-program input/output aliasing is admitted. The selected original fp32/i32 source view uses reviewed identity-materialization metadata with full expression comparison; other profiles, native refinement, concurrent aliased launches, GPU numerics and official comparator replay are separate obligations. A separate checked B=N=1 witness starts from empty registers and succeeds for all 24 profiles with every valid seed and runtime p in an explicit consistency algebra; it is not an IEEE or all-shape typed-success result.

declarations.dtype_profile: 25 ordered pairs of fp16/bf16/fp32/f8e4/f8e5 logical storage formats; explicit tensor promotion and cast back to x dtype, positive natural block size and complete ascending ceil grid. Arbitrary floating add/cast backend, including fp32; wrong-tag reads use logical defaults. No native storage/layout or full dtype domain claim.
unclosed_numeric_callbacks: M.binary none promoted_dtype add for every one of the five promoted floating dtypes, including fp32
M.cast none src dst for every distinct-format operand/output cast used by the 25 profiles

original_scope.covered: Complete execution/reference/frame of the five-format typed logical grid; dtype/cast-erased body equality to original DSL. Separate legacy/fp32/host/harness helpers remain supporting results.
remaining_structural_obligations: VA-S1: 192 promoted canonical dtype pairs outside the five-format 25-pair materialization. Full per-pair omissions are enumerated in dtype_pairs; includes 8 signed/unsigned widths, bool, fp64 and two fnuz formats. No unbounded Int/Nat addition is claimed as modular native addition.

VA-S2: 72 observed frontend promotion errors lack a complete source-bound host/compiler error proof. 289-entry Lean rule matches frozen observed table, not a proved Python/Triton semantic implementation. The 13 exact-source frontend probes do not establish 289 native backend outcomes or GPU execution.

VA-S3: Original dtype domain beyond the 17 canonical signatures. Torch int1/uint1 shell aliases, complex, quantized, packed and other unrecognized/shell dtypes are inventoried in frozen audit; allocation, canonicalization and exact error behavior remain uncharacterized.

VA-S4: Native memory, allocation and tensor metadata refinement. empty_like semantics including output dtype/shape/device/layout, allocation failures/freshness, input bounds despite absent shape checks, noncontiguous strides/storage offsets, same-device behavior, signed pointer arithmetic and physical allocation are not proved. No missing runtime guards are invented.

VA-S5: Finite-width launch and address arithmetic. Nat element counts, offsets, pid arithmetic, ceil division and grid dimensions require a source-bound refinement to n_elements:tl.int32 and finite native pids/address math, including overflow/error domains.

VA-S6: Logical tags and aliasing versus native byte-addressed views. Cell.read returns default on tag mismatch; typed-cell correspondence is unproved. Equal logical region names at identical natural offsets are supported. Distinct or overlapping physical views with different bases/strides/element widths are not established by that theorem.

VA-S7: Native launch scheduling and runtime/compiler/debug outcomes. runGrid is an ascending sequential program schedule. Previous programs read/write current logical memory and disjoint tile windows justify initial-memory formula. No concurrent instruction interleaving, arbitrary physical overlap, overflow sanitizer or full architecture-sensitive success/error theorem is supplied.

VA-S8: Host and harness native primitive implementation. HostWrapper preserves fallible stateful empty_like, CUDA guard, output-derived numel, explicit x/y/output metadata passed to launch, returns, seed/rand order, dictionary and result_gold module assignment. Those are logical control-flow definitions with native callbacks; original host/harness native execution and Python import/metadata behavior remain unbound. Its logicalLaunch theorem uses the legacy source; typed native dispatch is not composed.
Original Python caller, property/method access and non-Tensor attribute/type failures remain outside the logical Tensor record. Native Python/compiler translation is not verified.
original_scope.concrete_fp32_helper_boundary: SoftwareFP32.exact_grid and exact_typed_grid instantiate exact FP.add cfg, but the public theorem and wrapper retain arbitrary fp32 M.binary. VA-N1 helper/native binding does not instantiate that callback.
original_scope.host_boundary: logicalLaunch runs the legacy untagged-real source; dtype-sensitive native launch and typed wrapper composition are not established.
original_scope.native_cast_route: Distinct-format callbacks must bind full native routes, including bf16-to-fp16 through fp32; not a direct-cast equivalence claim.

declarations.review_basis: Root read all eight frozen producer modules, the separate thin specification wrapper, the original Python and existing Kernels source, and accepted the independent nine-module source/evidence review. Actual programs thread previous memory; disjoint flat tile offsets derive the initial-input formula even when x/y/output have equal logical region names. Typed source materializations explicitly promote operands and cast back to x storage for 25 ordered pairs over five floating formats. The public backend retains arbitrary add callbacks including fp32, and distinct-format casts. Identity casts are defined, not assumed. Exact SoftwareFP32 helpers are separate and do not instantiate the public backend. Dtype/cast erasure checks original source shape, not native typed lowering. All289 observed promotion entries match the Lean table;192 promoted pairs lack typed execution and72 observed errors lack full source-bound error proofs. Host/harness helpers retain allocation and error order, block1024, output-derived numel, metadata-aware native callbacks, seed/rand order and module assignment.
